response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_cost_to_rate_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112

assumptions.assumption: A long film is one with length at or above 112 minutes (inclusive cutoff), since 'using 112 minutes as the cutoff for a long film' does not say whether 112 itself counts.
Films with NULL length are excluded by the filter. rental_rate and replacement_cost are NOT NULL, and a zero rental_rate is not expected since the values are 0.99, 2.99 and 4.99.

alternatives.interpretation: Long films are strictly longer than 112 minutes (length > 112), so films of exactly 112 minutes are excluded.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_cost_to_rate_ratio FROM film WHERE length > 112
